name: Oogami Gentarou
source: A former Minister of Justice who made a name for himself in Showa-era politics. Having experienced World War II and internment in Siberia, he entered politics after returning to Japan. Guided by the conviction that "a nation must be controlled by politics," he dedicated himself to the recovery and stability of post-war Japan. A politician who has become the stuff of legend.
